description: Wait until text appears, text disappears, or an element becomes visible — for pages that load content after the fact (search results, spinners, SPAs). With no condition, waits timeoutMs. Fails with a clear message on timeout.

selector.description: Wait until an element matching this CSS selector is visible.

text.description: Wait until this text is on the page.

textGone.description: Wait until this text is gone (e.g. "Loading…").

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this long (default 10000, max 60000).

name: browser_wait
title: Wait for the page
